subject.title: Telegram: specific forum topic becomes permanent inbound black hole after stuck-session recovery

question: Does the related timed-out-spooled-lane repair sufficiently cover this persistent post-restart Telegram forum-topic black hole, or should this remain a separate live-investigation bug?
rationale: The related PR covers an in-process handler/guard path, but the issue and corroborating comment specifically report survival across gateway restarts and reply/slash-command asymmetry, which current source inspection does not conclusively explain.

options.title: Keep Separate Investigation
options.body: Keep this issue open and require live Telegram or restart-replay proof for the persistent topic-specific path before closing it.

options.title: Close After Broader Proof
options.body: Close this issue only if the lane-guard fix lands and maintainers add proof that a previously wedged forum topic recovers after a full gateway restart.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Investigation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require live Telegram or restart-replay proof for the persistent topic-specific path before closing it.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh has the strongest feature-history signal for the isolated spool, reply-fence, and restart recovery code involved in the decision.
